statement: Re3 (2025) demonstrates that a retrieval-agnostic framework combining temporal relevance with semantic similarity for versioned documents already exists, as it is described as a universal, plug-and-play framework that dynamically balances semantic and temporal information through a query-aware gating mechanism and can be integrated with existing dense retrievers.

evidence.quote: we propose Re3, a unified and lightweight framework that dynamically balances semantic and temporal information through a query-aware gating mechanism
universal, plug-and-play, and lightweight framework for TIR
can be seamlessly integrated with existing dense retrievers
designed to be a lightweight, plug-and-play retriever
